sources.title: Qwen3-4B - Qualcomm AI Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3-4B State‑of‑the‑art large language model useful on a variety of language understanding and generation tasks. The Qwen3‑4B is a state‑of‑the‑art multilingual base language model with 4 billion parameters, excelling in language understanding, generation, coding, and mathematics.

sources.title: Qwen 3 4B - Specs, Capabilities & Benchmarks | Inferbase
sources.snippet: Qwen 3 4B is a chat model developed by Qwen, offering capabilities such as function calling, JSON mode, reasoning, streaming, and text generation. It is genuinely best at delivering a comprehensive suite of dense and mixture-of-experts models, with significant enhancements in reasoning capabilities and superior human preference alignment.
